## Constraints

### Must

- Keep the existing desktop portfolio visually unchanged above 860px.
- Preserve the ruled-paper notebook identity and signal-blue accent.
- Use 44px minimum mobile interaction targets.

### Avoid

- Wrapped multi-row sticky navigation on mobile.
- Automatic looping video on mobile.
- Low-contrast scroll-dependent prose on mobile.

## Decisions

- At 860px and below, use a compact current-entry bar with an accessible two-column Entries disclosure. This preserves all nine destinations while reclaiming phone viewport height and leaving the desktop process rail unchanged.
